description: Approve or reject a pending conversion. Requires an Ultimate or Scale plan key with write access. Refunded conversions are terminal and cannot be changed. Approving a conversion whose commission is more than 5 times its sale (or any commission on a zero sale) is refused with commission_above_sale and changes nothing; show the user the returned sentence and set confirmAboveSale to true only after they confirm. If automatic payouts are switched on for the brand, approving a conversion queues its commission for the next automatic payout run (at least a day later, Stripe payouts only; affiliates paid by PayPal or Wise are paid by hand), and rejecting an approved one takes it back out of that queue. This tool never sends money itself.

confirmAboveSale.description: Approve even though the commission is more than 5 times its sale. Send true only after the user has seen the commission_above_sale message and confirmed it.

name: update_conversion
title: Approve or reject conversion
